summary: Independent review reproduced the original explicit strict:null rejection on the recorded base and verified that the exact candidate accepts and normalizes null to false for ResponsesRequest and ChatCompletionRequest. The normalized false value is retained by model_dump and by the Responses-to-Chat serving conversion. Omitted, false, and true inputs retain their established behavior.

tests.what_was_measured: Both ResponsesRequest and ChatCompletionRequest rejected explicit strict:null with bool_type while omitted and boolean values worked, reproducing the original issue. Raw output: reports/j-4eab53e9f497/raw/base_contract.txt

Explicit null was accepted and normalized to false in both request objects, both model_dump outputs, and the Responses-to-Chat conversion. Omitted/false/true behavior was preserved; object input remained invalid; existing Pydantic coercion of integer/string inputs was unchanged. Raw output: reports/j-4eab53e9f497/raw/candidate_contract.txt
The exact candidate passed 69 focused tests and 25 subtests, including its null-normalization regressions. Raw output: reports/j-4eab53e9f497/raw/candidate_pytest.txt
Actual JSON null input produced false in the request models and serialized output for both APIs. Raw output: reports/j-4eab53e9f497/raw/candidate_json_input.txt

The candidate has one trailing-whitespace line in reports/j-245abc24dc19/raw/focused_tests_after.txt; no product source or test code whitespace error was reported. Raw output: reports/j-4eab53e9f497/raw/candidate_diff_check.txt

gpu_evidence: No GPU execution was needed: the failure is deterministic Pydantic validation/serialization and an in-process serving conversion. The prepared environment reports PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but no model or GPU claim is made.
remaining_limitations: No live HTTP server/model test was run; request schema validation, JSON parsing, serialization, and the serving conversion were exercised directly without model weights.
No GPU architecture, model semantic accuracy, transport stack, or distributed behavior was validated because those are not involved in the original contract.
No native files changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The candidate contains trailing whitespace in a stored report artifact; this is non-functional and outside the source fix.
